description: This PHP file defines a class LangStringHelper that provides utility functions for managing internationalization language strings within a project, including database interactions for retrieving, inserting, updating, and deleting language string records.

classes.name: LangStringHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing language strings in the database, including CRUD operations and synchronization with YAML files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance for database queries.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of LanguageHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the group ID for a given module name.

methods.name: deleteNonCustomizedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes language strings that are not customized within a specified group.

methods.name: getLangStringIdsForGroup
methods.description: Fetches all language string IDs for a given group ID.

methods.name: getNonCustomizedLangStringIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of language strings that are marked as customized.

methods.name: insertOrUpdateLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from YAML files and inserts or updates them in the database accordingly.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByValueAndGroup
methods.description: Finds a language string ID based on its value and optional group ID.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByUnitIdAndGroup
methods.description: Finds a language string ID using its unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: saveLangString
methods.description: Inserts a new language string into the database.

methods.name: updateLangString
methods.description: Updates an existing language string record with new data.
